title: Origin Flag at a Folded Head
statement: Let $\Gamma$ and $S$ be types, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$ on input $x$, and let $i$ be a work-tape index. In the folded configuration of $c$, the origin flag in the unpacked symbol under tape $i$'s head is true exactly when that tape's folded head coordinate is zero.
hypotheses_covered: x is a list over Γ
c is a configuration with k work tapes and state set S on x
replaced:
In the folded image of a configuration $c$ of a $k$-work-tape machine over a base
alphabet, for each work tape the origin flag obtained by unpacking the physical
cell under that tape's head equals the truth value of the statement that the folded
head coordinate of that tape is $0$.
